<thought>To obtain the required precursors we first need the mapped reaction SMILES (mapped_rxn) for the template that performs amide formation from a carboxylic acid and an amine. The previous step (make_7_lvl2-template_search-1) asked for this mapped_rxn. We can retrieve it by searching the template catalog for a transformation that breaks a carboxylic acid and forms an amide. Using functional group criteria should locate the appropriate template and provide its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
